annotation.speech2: An arch drawn above a horizontal ground line, the x axis. The curve rises from the ground on the left to a single highest point on the y axis and comes back down to the ground on the right, symmetric about the y axis.
The arch y equals 50 minus 30 times hyperbolic cosine of x over 30, drawn where it lies above the ground.
The x axis is the ground line y equals 0; the y axis is the axis of symmetry of the arch.
